title: Phone scrolling and paste follow-up
summary: Bottom-edge scrolling and Send-side keyboard swipes now respect your touch, with fixes for empty DMs and native video paste recovery.

sections.heading: Scrolling and DMs
items: Automatic scroll corrections wait for the phone's bottom-edge bounce to settle. General, DMs, threads and Pins share the fix.
DMs retrieve messages that arrived during a bottom-edge gesture when following resumes.
New empty DM conversations now show their greeting instead of remaining hidden.

sections.heading: Keyboard and paste
items: The Send swipe handle no longer allows page panning; the compact down chevron remains available.
Native video paste recovers from empty clipboard formats and preserves accompanying text. This requires TestFlight Build 17; Home Screen video paste still depends on what iOS supplies.
Attachments remain in the composer for review and removal, then send with your text using the regular Send button.
Tap Restart Now to load this update.
